why: PROP-TRAIL: apply each prop leg's declared trail (trail_mult, trail-decay) by amending the resting SL through DXtradeAdapter.modify_bracket, never loosening and never clicking a close control. New src/prop/prop_trail.py replays scripts/backtest_trend.py's chandelier trail over closed bars since the signal bar with the shared src.research.trail_levers.effective_trail_mult; scripts/prop/prop_executor_tick.py runs it after run_cycle in the same mode (read_only walks disarmed). Close-type levers (stale_exit_bars on ETH) are alerted, not applied: a resting stop cannot reproduce a bar-close exit. Post-amend loosen guard restores and locks. Scope: executor-enabled venue symbols only (tradeify_1 declares none, unchanged).
